title: "If the accident will" - Paul Dean's (work)blog
subtitle: Hello! I’m Paul Dean, a writer, games designer and narrative designer, journalist and speaker. I have a Patreon which funds much of the independent work you read here. I’m known for features such as the hugely successful A Year in Stardew Valley and On Poverty, for my writing on video games like Pacific Drive or Maia, or on a host of tabletop games that include Paranoia, Feng Shui 2 and Magical Kitties Save the Day.
